normalised_claim: UK GDP grew by 0.5% in Q3 2025

evidence.title: ONS GDP Estimate - Q3 2025
evidence.text: The Office for National Statistics estimates that UK gross domestic product grew by 0.1% in Quarter 3 2025, following growth of 0.5% in Quarter 2. The services sector was the main contributor to growth.
evidence.snippet: The Office for National Statistics estimates that UK gross domestic product grew by 0.1% in Quarter 3 2025, following growth of 0.5% in Quarter 2.

evidence.title: UK economy shows resilience despite headwinds
evidence.text: Britain's economy continued to expand in the third quarter according to preliminary data, though at a slower pace than previously. Analysts had expected growth of around 0.3 per cent.
evidence.snippet: Britain's economy continued to expand in the third quarter according to preliminary data, though at a slower pace than previously.

evidence.title: Why the UK economy is still underperforming
evidence.text: Commentators have noted that while GDP is growing, the pace remains below trend. Some attribute this to persistent supply-side constraints and weak business investment.
evidence.snippet: Commentators have noted that while GDP is growing, the pace remains below trend.

normalised_claim: The Amazon rainforest lost 10,000 square kilometres of tree cover in 2024

elements.description: The Amazon rainforest experienced tree cover loss in 2024
The amount of tree cover lost was 10,000 square kilometres

evidence.title: INPE Deforestation Alert Data 2024
evidence.text: Brazil's National Institute for Space Research (INPE) recorded 8,453 square kilometres of deforestation alerts in the Legal Amazon region during 2024, a 22% reduction from the previous year's 10,834 sq km.
evidence.snippet: Brazil's National Institute for Space Research (INPE) recorded 8,453 square kilometres of deforestation alerts in the Legal Amazon during 2024.

evidence.title: Amazon deforestation falls to lowest level in six years
evidence.text: Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon dropped significantly in 2024, with satellite data showing the lowest annual rate since 2018. Environmental groups cautiously welcomed the decline.
evidence.snippet: Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon dropped significantly in 2024, with satellite data showing the lowest annual rate since 2018.

normalised_claim: Tesla delivered over 2 million vehicles globally in 2024

elements.description: Tesla made vehicle deliveries globally in 2024
The number of deliveries exceeded 2 million

evidence.title: Tesla Q4 and Full Year 2024 Delivery Report
evidence.text: Tesla reported total deliveries of 1,789,226 vehicles for full year 2024, down from 1,808,581 in 2023. This marked the company's first annual delivery decline.
evidence.snippet: Tesla reported total deliveries of 1,789,226 vehicles for full year 2024, down from 1,808,581 in 2023.

evidence.title: Electric vehicle market trends 2024
evidence.text: Global EV sales reached new records in 2024, driven by Chinese manufacturers. Tesla remained the single largest EV brand but faced growing competition.
evidence.snippet: Global EV sales reached new records in 2024. Tesla remained the single largest EV brand but faced growing competition.
